address: Cheval Blanc Paris, 8 quai du Louvre, Paris, 75001, France
bio: This brasserie, whose colourful decor is the work of Peter Marino, is tucked away on the seventh floor of the Cheval Blanc Hotel. Under the guidance of Arnaud Donckele, chef William Bequin, who boasts an enviable CV, means business. While he respects traditional brasserie rules, the consummate craftsmanship of each dish speaks for itself: macaroni with foie gras, truffle and artichoke, or grilled butterflied sea bass with sauce vierge de printemps. The desserts are the work of Maxime Frédéric. Another noteworthy detail is the terrace, with its breathtaking view of the Seine and the Left Bank....
